"""Prints the context_watch additionalContext for the CTO, a lead and an engineer (planted roots under TMPDIR)."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

TREE = Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-176")
HOOK = TREE / "template/governance/kernel/hooks/context_watch.py"
base = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="w2-176-texts-"))
transcript = base / "t.jsonl"
usage = {"input_tokens": 10, "cache_creation_input_tokens": 0, "cache_read_input_tokens": 0}
cases = {"cto": ("orchestrator", "DAEO-sdxk", 900_000), "lead": ("orchestrator", "DAEO-ktiw", 190_000),
         "engineer": ("engineer", "DAEO-ktiw", 190_000)}
for name, (role, ticket, used) in cases.items():
    root = base / name
    root.mkdir()
    if name == "cto":
        (root / ".tickets").mkdir()
        (root / ".tickets/DAEO-sdxk.md").write_text("---\nid: DAEO-sdxk\nclass: coordination\n---\n")
    if name == "lead":
        (root / ".git").write_text("gitdir: /nowhere\n")
    usage["input_tokens"] = used
    transcript.write_text(json.dumps({"type": "assistant", "isSidechain": False, "message": {
        "model": "claude-opus-5-5", "usage": usage}}) + "\n")
    event = {"hook_event_name": "PostToolUse", "session_id": "s", "transcript_path": str(transcript), "cwd": str(root)}
    env = {"PATH": os.environ["PATH"], "CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR": str(root), "GOV_ROLE": role, "GOV_TICKET": ticket,
           "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1"}
    done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(HOOK)], input=json.dumps(event), capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    print(f"--- {name} ({role}, {ticket}, opus at {used}) root={root}")
    print(json.loads(done.stdout)["hookSpecificOutput"]["additionalContext"])
for rel in ("template/governance/kernel/hooks/precompact.py", "template/governance/kernel/hooks/context_watch.py"):
    print(hashlib.sha256((TREE / rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), rel)
print("base:", base)
